# DigScript v0.1.0 release checklist

- [ ] A clean clone runs with `uv sync && uv run digscript`
- [ ] CI is green on both `ubuntu-22.04` and `windows-latest`
- [ ] `--selftest` passes on the frozen binary
- [ ] Manual playthrough: run the starter script, unlock the first achievements,
      sell ore, buy the Backpack upgrade
